q1.sampleAnswer: AI has the ability for a computer to think and learn.

keyPoints.descZh: AI 是让电脑能思考和学习的能力
examples: the ability for a computer to think and learn

q1.rubricZh: 要点：电脑思考和学习的能力。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段给出了 AI 的意思：让电脑像人一样思考和学习。

evidence.quote: Artificial intelligence*, or AI, is the ability for a computer to think and learn.

q2.sampleAnswer: People show an AI programme thousands of images of dogs.

keyPoints.descZh: 给 AI 看成千上万张狗的图片

q2.rubricZh: 要点：成千上万张狗的图片。
q2.explanationZh: 第四段第一句说人们给 AI 程序看成千上万张狗的图片。

evidence.quote: People show an AI programme thousands of images of dogs.

q3.sampleAnswer: We can ask a virtual assistant to play music. / We can ask a virtual assistant to turn on the lights. / We can ask a virtual assistant to tell us the weather.

keyPoints.descZh: 任答一个例子：播放音乐、开灯、告诉我们天气
examples: ask a virtual assistant to play music
ask it to turn on the lights
ask it to tell us the weather

q3.rubricZh: 要点：任答一个例子即可。
q3.explanationZh: 第五段列了三个例子：说天气、放音乐、开灯，写出其中一个就行。

evidence.quote: You can ask a virtual assistant* to tell you the weather.

q4.sampleAnswer: It may send me ads for similar books.

keyPoints.descZh: 可能发来类似书籍的广告

q4.explanationZh: 第六段说网上买东西时，AI 可能发来相似东西的广告；买的是书，所以是类似的书。

evidence.quote: When you buy something online, AI may send you ads for similar things.

q5.sampleAnswer: Because AI is all around us.

keyPoints.descZh: 因为 AI 无处不在

q5.explanationZh: 最后一段的两句话是因果关系：因为 AI 就在我们身边，所以应该多了解它。

q6.explanationZh: 第三、四段用认狗来举例，说明 AI 也能自己学会分辨其他动物，所以说法错。

evidence.quote: It can teach itself the differences between dogs and other animals.

q7.explanationZh: 文章开头把 Siri 当作 AI 的例子，Siri 就是一种虚拟助手。

evidence.quote: Have you ever heard of Siri*?

q8.explanationZh: 第六段说 AI 会在网上购物时推荐相似的东西，所以说法对。

evidence.quote: When you buy something online, AI may send you ads for similar things.

q9.explanationZh: 第四段说 AI 能自己学会分辨，不需要人教每一个区别。

evidence.quote: It can teach itself the differences between dogs and other animals.
